method_notes: Started from the 124 football-stadium records in football-stadiums.json that carried no calendar_sources entry, ordered by capacity, and worked down from the largest. Every club site was first fetched with a plain unauthenticated GET and fingerprinted (server, framework, inline config, referenced API hosts, own outbound links); sitemaps and the pages' own nav links were used to find fixture routes rather than guessing paths, and a browser render was used only where static HTML proved insufficient. The single biggest finding is a shared white-label club-site platform ("gc"): a Nuxt SPA served from S3/CloudFront with per-club config VUE_APP_CLUB_ID and per-club API hosts matches.football.admin.gc.<club>services.<tld> - 44 of these stadiums run it, all exposing forthcoming fixtures at the identical path https://<club-domain>/matches, with the page's own inline state carrying kickOff:"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" values and a public JSON endpoint at matches.football.web.gc.<club>services.<tld>/v2/opta?clientMatches=true&teamID=<optaTeamID>&seasonID=<year>&pageSize=100 (team IDs enumerated by filters.football.web.gc.<club>services.<tld>/v2/filters); 43 of the 44 were individually confirmed to list 27-43 forthcoming dated fixtures each, so one collector would unlock all of them. Two smaller shared platforms were also confirmed: YinzCam (Leicester City, Brighton & Hove Albion, Birmingham City - cmscdnus.yinzcam.com, /pages/en/ routes and match-centre?gameId=), and an /en/-prefixed CMS shared by Chelsea, Southampton and Brentford (match permalinks /en/match/<home>-vs-<away>-<competition>-<yyyy-mm-dd>). Sites that blocked or defeated this pass, and for which nothing was recorded: mancity.com (HTTP 403 Cloudflare, so Academy Stadium is unresolved), suttonunited.net (HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge, so Gander Green Lane is unresolved), and the Merthyr Town Pitchero club site ("Club not live"). Several census official_url values are wrong or hijacked and were not used as evidence - basingstoketown.net, bowerhintonbears.co.uk, formartineutd.com, airbusfc.com, santiagofutsal.com and penybontfc.com now serve casino/SEO spam, dns.google is recorded for Fortwilliam Park, and halifaxafc.co.uk is a defunct different club (the live FC Halifax Town site was located and used instead). Most of the ~64 stadiums still without a calendar are sub-3,000-capacity non-league or Scottish/Northern Irish junior grounds with no official_url in the census at all; only no-calendar records were patched, so no existing calendar_sources entry can be overwritten by this file.
